mappings.requirement_text: Secure logging must make it possible to detect security events and enable forensic analysis.
Secure logging requires that logs are not dropped or truncated before use.
Protection of confidentiality in transit and storage: data at rest uses encryption.
Cryptography requires state-of-the-art mechanisms including key management.
Products must restrict access through authentication, authorisation, and least-privilege.
Security event detection and alerting must remain functional.
